raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Follow-up to #43735. DSA models with EAGLE MTP can now enable `--enable-hierarchical-cache` with `--dcp-size > 1` (L2 only; L3, PD, HiSparse and LMCache stay rejected).

- The DSA index-K cache is replicated across DCP ranks, so its host mirror now spans the anchor's widened (logical) slot space instead of the per-rank rows, and addresses the device index without rank translation.
- Under DCP the MTP draft is registered as a sidecar host pool (the existing DSpark path, sized to logical slots) instead of being packed into the sharded KV rows.
- The HiCache DCP launch rule admits DSA MTP; the sidecar host-size estimate counts the widened slots.

Tests: a CPU unit case for the indexer host pool sizing in `test_hicache_dcp_host_pool.py`, and `test/registered/dcp/test_glm53_dcp2_hicache.py` (GLM-5.3-NVFP4 TP4 DCP2 MTP with HiCache L2: GSM8K plus the multi-turn KL cache-hit suite, bf16 KV, widened-page cache asserts).

Validation on 8xB300, GLM-5.3 FP8, TP4 DCP2 + MTP, bf16 KV, multi-turn KL (logprobs_match / prefill_hit / decode_hit):
- no HiCache: 0.015 / 0.013 / 0.013
- HiCache with forced host reloads (16k-token device pool, 26k tokens served from host): 0.012 / 0.016 / 0.013
- HiCache, normal pool: 0.019 / 0.015 / 0.016, GSM8K 0.930 (0.925 with fp8 KV)

+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.unified_radix_cache_kit import UnifiedRadixTreeTestMixin
+from sglang.test.kl_multiturn_utils import (
+    get_input_ids,
+    make_mamba_decode_assert,
+    make_mamba_prefill_assert,
+)
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.dsa_mtp_fixture import DsaMtpServerBase
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=900, stage="extra-b", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+DCP_SIZE = 2
+WIDENED_PAGE = 64 * DCP_SIZE
+
+
+class TestGLM53NVFP4DCP2MTPHiCache(DsaMtpServerBase, UnifiedRadixTreeTestMixin):
+    """GLM-5.3 TP4 + DCP2 + MTP with HiCache L2: host-mirrored KV, index keys and draft KV must replay."""
+
+    model = "RadixArk/GLM-5.3-NVFP4"
+    tp_size = 4
+    mem_fraction_static = 0.8
+    gsm8k_threshold = 0.88
+    kl_threshold = 0.02
+    prefill_cache_assert = staticmethod(
+        make_mamba_prefill_assert(chunk_size=WIDENED_PAGE)
+    )
+    decode_cache_assert = staticmethod(
+        make_mamba_decode_assert(track_interval=WIDENED_PAGE)
+    )
+    extra_server_args = [
+        "--quantization",
+        "modelopt_fp4",
+        "--kv-cache-dtype",
+        "bfloat16",
+        "--dcp-size",
+        str(DCP_SIZE),
+        "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
+        "--hicache-ratio",
+        "1.5",
+        "--hicache-write-policy",
+        "write_through",
+        "--random-seed",
+        "0",
+    ]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=cls.get_server_args(),
+            env={"SGLANG_ENABLE_RANK_CONSENSUS_CHECKER": "1"},
+        )
+        cls.input_ids = get_input_ids(cls.model, num_samples=12, trust_remote_code=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+def _fake_dsa_device_pool(size: int = 1024) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    logical = size * DCP_SIZE
+    elems = 128 + 128 // 128 * 4
+    buffers = [
+        torch.zeros(
+            (logical + PHYSICAL_PAGE) // PHYSICAL_PAGE,
+            PHYSICAL_PAGE * elems,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+        )
+        for _ in range(2)
+    ]
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        index_k_with_scale_buffer=buffers,
+        index_page_size=PHYSICAL_PAGE,
+        page_size=PHYSICAL_PAGE,
+        index_head_dim=128,
+        quant_block_size=128,
+        skip_topk_layers=[False, False],
+        store_dtype=torch.float16,
+        layer_num=2,
+        start_layer=0,
+        end_layer=1,
+        device="cpu",
+        layer_shard_enabled=False,
+    )
+
+
+class TestDsaIndexerHostPoolUnderDcp(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_host_index_pages_cover_the_replicated_device_index(self):
+        """The index-K host mirror holds a page for every widened slot, untranslated."""
+        anchor = _make_host_pool(dcp_rank=3)
+        self.addCleanup(anchor.destroy)
+        pool = _fake_dsa_device_pool()
+        host = DSAIndexerPoolHost(
+            decl=make_dsa_indexer_pool_decl(pool), anchor_host=anchor, pin_memory=False
+        )
+        self.addCleanup(host.destroy)
+        self.assertEqual(host.page_size, PHYSICAL_PAGE)
+        self.assertEqual(host.size, anchor.logical_size)
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(
+            host.indexer_page_num * PHYSICAL_PAGE, anchor.logical_size
+        )
+        last_page = anchor.logical_size - WIDENED_PAGE
+        logical = torch.arange(last_page, last_page + WIDENED_PAGE)
+        with mock.patch(
+            "sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.dsa.transfer_kv_all_layer_mla",
+            create=True,
+        ) as kernel:
+            host.backup_from_device_all_layer(pool, logical, logical.clone(), "kernel")
+        kwargs = kernel.call_args.kwargs
+        expected = torch.arange(
+            last_page // PHYSICAL_PAGE, anchor.logical_size // PHYSICAL_PAGE
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(kwargs["src_indices"], expected)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(kwargs["dst_indices"], expected)
+        self.assertLess(int(expected.max()), host.indexer_page_num)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
